scripts.build: npm run prepare-cli && ray build -e dist

commands.name: manage-displays
commands.title: Manage Displays
commands.description: List displays and control an individual display

commands.name: external-on
commands.title: Reconnect External Displays
commands.description: Reconnect all external displays disconnected by ScreenOff

commands.name: external-off
commands.title: Disconnect External Displays
commands.description: Disconnect all external displays while keeping them recoverable

commands.name: toggle-external
commands.title: Toggle External Displays
commands.description: Disconnect all when connected; otherwise reconnect all external displays
